SELECT b.product_id, b.mth, b.qty AS budget_qty, o.qty AS order_qty,
       i.qty AS inventory_total, p.qty_minimum, p.qty_purchase
FROM main.monthly_budget AS b
JOIN main.product_minimums AS p ON p.product_id = b.product_id
JOIN main.inventory_totals AS i ON i.product_id = b.product_id
LEFT JOIN main.monthly_orders AS o ON o.product_id = b.product_id AND o.mth = b.mth
WHERE b.mth >= '2019-01-01'
ORDER BY b.product_id, b.mth
